fuel_consumption_l_100km.source: European Commission, COM(2024) 122 final, report on real-world CO2 emissions and fuel consumption of cars and vans (OBFCM), Table 3: average real-world fuel consumption of diesel cars
fuel_consumption_l_100km.applicability: EU, new diesel passenger cars registered in 2021
fuel_consumption_l_100km.notes: Real-world (on-board fuel consumption meter) value; the WLTP type-approval value in the same table is 5.82 L/100 km.

fuel_emission_factor_g_per_l.source: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero, Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026, Scope 1 fuels, Diesel (average biofuel blend), kg CO2e per litre = 2.58354
fuel_emission_factor_g_per_l.applicability: UK forecourt diesel blend; combustion only (tank-to-wheel), well-to-tank excluded
fuel_emission_factor_g_per_l.notes: CO2e with AR5 global-warming potentials; the CO2-only component is 2.55035 kg/L. 100 % mineral diesel: 2.66155 kg CO2e/L.

provenance.notes: Platform preset: consumption from an EU regulatory report, fuel factor from the UK government conversion factors. Override any value with your own documented figure.
